environment: Full locked Hermes Native agent-automation suite (654 library + 15 protocol + 3 launcher), all-target cargo check, Windows debug desktop build, rustfmt and diff checks. No live Hermes Gateway or installed Hermes app was used.
notes: Pinned agent_init_failed now displays a dedicated recovery explanation and opens the current chat model picker through the existing model-change route. The Retry action remains controlled by Hermes error_surface.retryable; a nonretryable init error still offers model selection but cannot retry. A rendered egui interaction verifies the recovery action opens the picker, and a mapping regression covers both retryable and nonretryable cases. This does not implement provider API-key editing or provider-scoped OAuth reauthentication, which require a native provider-credential API. PAR-0064 remains partial; live Gateway, packaged Windows, remaining error actions, and formal source-paired acceptance remain open.
